gang-fall-party.new_intro: A cartoon arena fighter about shoving other players off the edge. It supports a local 1v1 on one keyboard, bigger online matches, and a two-player Vs All mode where you both take on everyone else. Good for quick rotation at a party.

castle-wars-legacy.new_title: Castle Wars: Legacy – Online Card Duel Game | Games for Many
castle-wars-legacy.new_description: Build a deck, defend your castle and break through your opponent's walls. Play online duels, tournaments, campaign or AI practice.

castle-wars-legacy.new_intro: A tactical card duel that mixes resource management, castle building and direct attacks. carrom-pro.new_intro: Carrom Pro is a browser carrom board with realistic collision physics and three rulesets. Classic Carrom follows the standard rules you'd play on a real wooden board. All modes are local pass-and-play – two people share one device and take turns aiming with the striker. Feels closer to a real board than most browser carrom versions.

turkish-draughts.new_title: Turkish Draughts – Play Online, AI or 2 Player | Games for Many
turkish-draughts.new_description: Play Turkish draughts online. Pieces move and capture horizontally and vertically – not diagonally. Face AI, a friend on one device, or online.

turkish-draughts.new_intro: The Turkish variant of draughts, where pieces move and capture up-down and left-right instead of diagonally. That small rule change makes the whole board feel different – lots of familiar tactics stop working. Three modes: AI, same-device 2 player, and online opponent.

dominoes-classic-duel.new_title: Dominoes Online – Play Classic Dominoes Free (AI & Multiplayer) | Games for Many

music-night-battle-rhythm-game.new_title: Music Night Battle – Online Rhythm Duel Game | Games for Many
music-night-battle-rhythm-game.new_description: Tap arrows in time with the beat in a fast online rhythm battle. Build combos, climb the leaderboard and duel other players in music matches.

music-night-battle-rhythm-game.new_intro: A rhythm duel with a neon arcade look. You tap arrow keys in time with the beat while another player does the same, and combos decide who wins. Fast, reaction-heavy, and easy to jump into – solo mode is there if you just want to practice timing.

greedy-snake-multiplayer-duel.new_title: Greedy Snake Multiplayer Duel – Online Snake Game | Games for Many
greedy-snake-multiplayer-duel.new_description: Play a cartoon-style online snake duel. Eat, grow longer, and keep enough room to turn while your opponent tries to trap you.
greedy-snake-multiplayer-duel.new_h1: Greedy Snake Multiplayer Duel – Online Snake Battle
greedy-snake-multiplayer-duel.new_intro: A colorful Snake duel with a chunky cartoon style. The core loop is the classic one – eat, grow longer, don't crash into yourself – but the online opponent adds a real trap-and-block layer on top. Familiar enough to pick up in a minute.

battle-jitsu.new_title: Battle Jitsu – Online Elemental Card Duel | Games for Many
battle-jitsu.new_description: Pick fire, water or ice cards and outguess your opponent in a fast online card duel. Small deck, quick matches, all about reading the other player.
battle-jitsu.new_h1: Battle Jitsu – Elemental Card Duel Online
battle-jitsu.new_intro: A small-deck online card duel built around a rock-paper-scissors style element cycle – fire, water, ice. Matches are short and lean on guessing what the other player will pick rather than memorizing a huge card list. Good starter card game.

mcatlants.new_title: MCATLANTS – 2 Player Local Co-op Platformer | Games for Many

black-and-white-stickman.new_intro: A co-op platformer starring two stick figures – one white, one black. Both need to collect the stars and monster balls in each level and make it to the portal together. Coordination matters more than speed; leaving your partner behind usually stalls the run.

duo-water-and-fire.new_title: Fire and Water 2 Player Game – Duo Water and Fire | Games for Many

duo-water-and-fire.new_intro: The classic fire-and-water two-player formula in a clean browser version. One player controls the water character, the other controls fire. Water burns in lava, fire dies in water, both need to grab the key and reach the exit together. Play on one keyboard – WASD for one character, arrow keys for the other. Levels get trickier as switches, buttons and moving platforms enter the mix. No download and no ads mid-level.

kingdom-of-toilets.new_title: Kingdom of Toilets – 2 Player Escape Platformer | Games for Many

kingdom-of-toilets.new_h1: Kingdom of Toilets – Co-op Escape Platformer
kingdom-of-toilets.new_intro: A shared-keyboard escape platformer with two toilet robots stuck in an underground obstacle course. table-pong.new_description: Play table tennis with a friend on one keyboard. Simple controls, fast rallies and a clean design – rotate players between matches.

table-pong.new_intro: A local table tennis duel where two players share one keyboard. Rules are the ones you'd expect – hit the ball back, first to the score wins – so there's nothing to learn. imposter-duck-online.new_title: Imposter Duck Online – Social Deduction Game | Games for Many
